name: @latticekit/example-migration
description: MIGRATION — a gallery exhibit. A v1 save opened by a v5 build, stepping the chain in front of you.
$comment: Seven of nine, and the subject is `@latticekit/persist`: five sealed builds of one chain, a real store, a real checksum, and a real recognizer at every rung. `sim` and `audio` are absent because an archive yard has no economy and no sound.
